profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer | Cloud Architect | iOS & Android App | AWS Evangelist | Sci-fi Enthusiast
profile.summary:
Hey there, I’m Coel! I’ve been lucky enough to turn my love for tech into a career that lets me bring cool ideas to life. One of the highlights? 

As a full-stack developer, I’ve worked across the board, from configuring AWS architecture to streamlining CI/CD pipelines and consulting on all kinds of software stacks. Dropping into unfamiliar codebases and getting up to speed quickly is kind of my thing—it’s a challenge I genuinely enjoy. I’ve also had the chance to lead teams and embrace Agile methodologies, which has taught me a lot about collaboration and problem-solving.

When I’m not coding, I’m hanging out with my girlfriend (and just as importantly her dog), solving puzzles, or diving into sci-fi books. The Three-Body Problem trilogy was hands-down my favorite read of 2024. Stay tuned for my 2025 update.
*** 2025 Update: Dungeon Crawler Carl has become my favorite re-read! ***

If you ever want to geek out about cloud computing, database management, development or your favorite sci-fi universe, I’m your guy. Let’s connect!

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Always Connect Solutions is a B2B connectivity company providing cellular routers, SIM cards, data plans, and IoT solutions to businesses that can't afford downtime. 

 

As Principal Software Engineer, I lead development of the ACS customer portal, the platform our customers use to manage their connectivity solutions. My work spans full-stack development, cloud architecture on AWS, and building systems that are reliable, scalable, and built to grow with the business. 

 

I own the product from architecture decisions through to deployment, working closely with leadership to make sure the technology we build matches where the company is going.

projects.title: Lego Trader
projects.description: A full stack application focused on trading Lego sets.  Using a Node.js backend and a Vue.js frontend, Lego Trader allows users to browse past and present sets, add them to Owned or Wishlist lists, mark them for trade and offer sets to other users.  Users can also post and comment on our Forum page.  Live chat is available between trade parties and all trades occur live.  A notification system lets users know when they have a new trade offer, a Wishlist item is available for trade or if user's post has been commented on.
